input.prompt: Using this soldier character only as a colour reference (olive green, dark gunmetal, small cyan accents), draw a single game prop on its own in a realistic, photoreal 3D render style with physically based materials, NOT comic or cel-shaded, no outlines, so it sits naturally on realistic jungle ground and rock textures.
